title: RecordSift import result report
description: Proposed version 1.0 JSON report for one import source. This contract is not an implemented .NET API.

schemaVersion.description: Serialized contract version, independent of the RecordSift package version.

sourceId.description: Caller-provided opaque source identifier, never an absolute filesystem path or credential.

status.description: Completed means import processing finished, including possible rejected records; Failed means a source/schema or other fatal failure.

message.description: Human-readable informational or failure summary. Consumers must rely on status and diagnostics for decisions.

diagnostics.description: Individual findings in deterministic processing order. Never include raw source values by default.

processedCount.description: Number of logical data records processed (excluding headers).

acceptedCount.description: Number of processed records accepted; warnings alone do not reject a record.

rejectedCount.description: Number of distinct processed records with at least one error-level record diagnostic.

warningRowCount.description: Number of distinct processed records with at least one warning-level record diagnostic; may overlap with rejectedCount.

scope.description: Record refers to a logical data record; Source refers to a file/schema/import-level problem.

row.description: One-based logical data-record ordinal excluding CSV headers; null for Source diagnostics.

field.description: Declared source field name or identifier when applicable; null otherwise.

severity.description: Validation level of this individual diagnostic.

code.description: Stable machine-readable diagnostic identifier; registry established during implementation.

message.description: Human-readable explanation without raw source data or full file paths by default.

worksheet.description: Optional XLSX worksheet name when available.

physicalRow.description: Optional 1-based physical XLSX row or reliable source row location.

physicalLine.description: Optional physical CSV line only if the reader provides it reliably.
